what: The Industry Wire as it was in its vault when this site was last released: headlines and primary links, each story's edition and dated corrections, the desk's latest release note. The live edition is the vault (u9i9jp0l); this file is the fallback and the index for agents.
kind: update edition: news since the 11 October run, plus corrections to that edition

latest_release.title: Update edition, 13 October
latest_release.summary: Nineteen new stories since Sunday's run. Lead: the UK's AI defence package, which could put AI loss of control and incident and near-miss reporting into the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill; frontier labs were invited to the Business and Trade Committee today. Also worth your attention: an access broker running Claude Code across 51 agents (sec-13), Torvalds labelling a Claude Code kernel patch (oss-09), a CVSS 10 in GitLab CI (sec-12), and Windows Update certificates expiring in 2027 (sec-15). Thirteen stories from 11 October were updated after their primary sources were fetched; the main correction is that the US executive order does not create the Super Intelligence Force (gov-04). Your lane was not read, so your five wire decisions are not reflected yet.
